name: glacier-magma
description: Glacier & Magma - animated 3D elemental chess with online multiplayer, spectators and AI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w server -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w server
